title: Opening a search result opens its room on the message
spec: REQUIREMENTS 2.1: opening a search result opens the room around it. Clicking a result opens its room and makes its message the window's focus (Window::focus): the bubble is outlined and the feed scrolls it to the middle once (the feed does not stick to the bottom until then); the focus waits for the room's messages if they have not arrived. A result that is a reply opens its thread and focuses its parent in the conversation. Opening another room drops the focus.
